spec: Both E1 and E5 present and PASSED, with a strictly validated measured peak-memory block: ram_measured must be true with a positive finite numeric ram_peak_bytes; GPU-capable hardware must carry a measured numeric vram_peak_bytes; CPU-only hardware must document VRAM unavailability with a non-empty reason and a null value. Unknown capability fails closed.

verified_source.inspection: independent source read of check_peak_memory() and device_capability(), not inherited from prior reports
verified_source.logic: both E1 and E5 required (missing -> fail, never skipped); status must be PASSED; peak_memory must be an object; ram_measured/ram_peak_bytes required and type-checked; ram_peak_bytes must be numeric, finite, >0; vram_measured required bool; capability from cuda_available / gpu_model / cuda_version / vram_total_bytes; Unknown -> fail closed ('refusing to classify as CPU-only')

evidence_distinction.allocated_bytes: accounting.nominal_parameter_payload_bytes / accounting.stored_parameter_bytes -- parameter footprint, NOT the G4 peak
evidence_distinction.peak_bytes: peak_memory.ram_peak_bytes -- the process-global peak actually sampled by the harness; THIS is the value G4 validates
evidence_distinction.device_reported_bytes: peak_memory.vram_peak_bytes -- VRAM; documented as unavailable on this CPU-only host with a non-empty reason and null value

cases: ram_peak_bytes invalid types and non-positive/non-finite values -> FAIL
valid CPU-only VRAM unavailability reason -> PASS
G1 fail-closed: malformed PROFILE hardware does not crash, sets G1 FAIL

aggregator_results.controlled_valid: exit 0 - G4 PASS ('E1 and E5 present, PASSED, RAM peak measured; VRAM source documented per schema')
aggregator_results.controlled_invalid_g4: exit 1 - G4 FAIL (E1 peak_memory.ram_measured set to false)
aggregator_results.controlled_invalid_g2: exit 1 - G4 FAIL (E5 record absent; G4 never skips a baseline)

real_historical_result.over_recovered_records: PASS - E1 (6 records) + E5 (3 records) all PASSED; all 9 records carry ram_measured=true with a positive finite ram_peak_bytes; hardware cuda_available=false with a documented VRAM-unavailable object (reason + null value); provenance present
real_historical_result.provenance_check: all 9 records embed hardware provenance (cpu_model source) and the CPU-only VRAM unavailability reason; device_capability() classifies them CPU (explicit cuda_available=false)
real_historical_result.over_surviving_originals_build_results: FAIL - E5 baseline record absent, so G4 cannot be satisfied
real_historical_result.over_regenerated_build_historical_regen: PASS - E1 and E5 present, PASSED, RAM peak measured; VRAM source documented

decision: PASS on implementation, tests, and recovered historical data (G4 PASS). Fail-closed behaviour for undecodable hardware evidence strengthened by the v1.8 G1 fix.
recommendation: G4 satisfied over real recovered data; thresholds unchanged.
